svg.title: proofreader_evolve: the data the search runs on
svg.desc: Data model of proofreader_evolve as a growing table. One row per candidate of a frozen detector pool per brain and kind: a merge row is one junction node, a split row is one fragment pair with one or more occurrences. Columns: host-only identities, native predictors x_i from the detector, detector_score, agent-added columns z_i (local_* from LOCAL_CONTEXT, bank_agent_* from descriptors, image features), and the output score s_i. Labels y_i are held apart by the host. Rows are ranked by detector_score; the top band (at most 20,000 rows) carries attached contexts c_i: a 50 um fragment neighbourhood and image patches at level 1 (30 um) and level 0 (16 um). Agent code phi turns contexts into columns (describe, extract_local_features, extract_image_features) or a model reads raw patches directly in training.py; f ranks rows from x_i and z_i. Coverage differs per feature (cache band, LOCAL_CONTEXT default 5,000, descriptor scopes pilot, boundary, all_cached); uncovered rows are NaN but every row is scored. Label access by role: the agent session sees TRAIN labelled samples and label-conditional statistics; the fit worker sees TRAIN labels of the fitting rows; describe, extract and predict workers see no labels; the outer evaluator holds validation labels. New columns are judged by paired ablation on TRAIN (diagnostic), grouped out-of-fold Precision@K on the selection brain (a constraint against memorising, not proof), and the hidden-brain promotion gate with the bootstrap bound (the only gate).

g.text: any CPU learner on x, z

svg.text: φ runs label-free; only the agent session and the fit worker see TRAIN labels. The host re-executes the frozen φ and f on the validation tables.
Detector columns and pools come from Stage 2 and never change inside a run; the agent's columns and models are versioned by code hash.
What the agent can do that a fixed feature set cannot
When the existing columns cannot separate two candidates, it proposes a new measurement from the image or the skeleton, writes it as code, and the host checks whether that
measurement improves the ranking of the fixed rows. The observation space grows; the candidate set, K and labels stay put. Feature discovery and model search feed each other.
